test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Vijay sells bananas at the rate of Rs. 13 per dozen and earns a profit of 30 percent. The cost price of the bananas increases by 10 percent. If the selling price remains the same, then what is his new profit percent?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the initial Cost Price (CP) be 100 units.

Since the initial profit is 30%, Selling Price (SP) = 130 units.

The new CP increases by 10%, so New CP = 110 units.

Since the SP remains the same (130 units), New Profit = 130 − 110 = 20 units.

New Profit % = (20 ÷ 110) × 100 = 18.18%.

**∴ The correct answer is 18.18%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) of bananas = Rs. 13 per dozen

Initial Profit = 30%

Cost Price increases by 10% and SP remains the same.

**Formula Used:**

CP = (SP × 100) ÷ (100 + Profit%)

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91479e78d83e8245bc1f567ee460f7c4a22ad02a82c1e5c77aaa1f0aee9d7f00.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Initial CP = (13 × 100) ÷ (100 + 30)

⇒ Initial CP = 1300 ÷ 130 = Rs. 10

⇒ New CP = Initial CP + 10% of Initial CP

⇒ New CP = 10 + (10 ÷ 100) × 10 = Rs. 11

⇒ The Selling Price remains the same, so New SP = Rs. 13

⇒ New Profit = New SP − New CP = 13 − 11 = Rs. 2

⇒ New Profit % = (New Profit ÷ New CP) × 100

⇒ New Profit % = (2 ÷ 11) × 100 = 18.18%

**∴ The correct answer is 18.18%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price (MP) and Discount

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price. Selling Price (SP) = MP − Discount. Furthermore, Discount % = (Discount ÷ MP) × 100.

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts of a% and b% are given on an article, Effective Single Discount = a + b − (a × b ÷ 100)%.

Dishonest Dealer Trick

If a dealer sells goods at CP but uses a false weight, his Profit % = [Error ÷ (True Value − Error)] × 100.
